item.title: Petition for Sadiq Khan to resign over 'grooming gangs denial' to be presented at City Hall
item.description: A petition with more than 40,000 signatures calling for London Mayor Sir Sadiq Khan to resign over his denial of the existence of grooming gangs in London is set to be delivered to City Hall. item.title: Universities which let extremism run riot to be shut amid Islamist fears on campuses
item.description: Universities that fail to tackle extremism on campus could face sanctions and even be forced to close, the Education Secretary has said. item.description: Vladimir Putin was spotted struggling to speak as he became embroiled in a coughing fit while trying to deliver an address from the Kremlin. item.title: Bible sales surge to highest level on record as Britain's Christian revival continues
item.description: Bible sales have surged to their highest levels since records began as Britain's Christian revival continues to sweep the nation. According to data firm NielsenIQ BookData, the numbers of Britons buying Bibles jumped by 19 per cent last year - taking the total to its highest since 1998. item.title: Green Party would force Britons to hold licence to keep dogs as pets
item.description: The Green Party would force Britons to hold a licence to keep dogs as pets should it win the next General Election. Zack Polanski's party intends to push the measure on more than 13.5 million British dog owners, policy documents on its website show.Dog licences were axed in Britain in 1987, but all pooches have been required to be microchipped since 2013.The Greens would establish a "two-tier" dog licencing system, with different rules applying to those who breed the animals.
